Q. 1 زَرْجَنَةٌ (as an inf. n. TK) i. q. تَخَارُجٌ [q. v.]: (K) one says, زَرْجَنُوا, meaning تَخَارَجُوا. (TK.) ―
-b2- And The being deceitful, wicked, dishonest, or dissimulating, and mischief-making; or very deceitful &c.: and the act of deceiving, deluding, beguiling, circumventing, or outwitting: (K:) one says, زَرْجَنَهُ, meaning He deceived him, deluded him, &c. (TK.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
